item.title: Bucks’ courtside season ticket holder club gets new name
item.description: The Milwaukee Bucks’ exclusive courtside season ticket holder club at Fiserv Forum, formerly known as The Reserve, is getting a new name – Gallagher Club. item.title: Modine to spin off performance technologies unit, merge it with Gentherm in $1 billion deal
item.description: Modine plans to spin off its performance technologies business and combine it with Gentherm, turning its focus to the data center market.

item.title: Fresenius to lay off 41 workers at Kenosha distribution center
item.description: Fresenius USA Manufacturing will eliminate 41 positions at its Kenosha distribution center, according to a new WARN notice.

item.title: Port Washington land sold to data center developer for $9.3 million

item.description: A new study commissioned by the Wisconsin Center District concludes that downtown Milwaukee needs a large convention headquarters hotel to remain competitive with other cities in attracting conventions and identifies the Miller High Life Theatre site as the most viable location for such a project. item.title: MMAC sues City of Port Washington over referendum related to TID financing
item.description: MMAC and local business groups sue Port Washington over an April ballot measure requiring voter approval for large TID-funded development projects.
